blocks.explanation:
Is series mein signs ka ek pattern hai: plus, plus, minus, phir plus, plus, minus. Is liye poori series A.P. nahi hai, aur seedha formula nahi lag sakta.
Diya kya hai? Series aur terms ki tadaad \(3n\).
Find kya karna hai? \(3n\) terms ka jama.
Plan: teen teen terms ke groups banana (\(3n\) terms ke \(n\) groups banenge); har group ka jama nikalna; yeh jame khud A.P. banayenge; phir us A.P. ka jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3 + 5 - 7 + 9 + 11 - 13 + \dots\) \(3n\) terms tak.
Humein find karna hai: jama.
Tareeqa: Signs hata kar dekhein to numbers 3, 5, 7, 9, ... 2, 2 barh rahe hain. Signs har teen terms baad dohrate hain, is liye teen teen ka group banayenge: \((3 + 5 - 7) + (9 + 11 - 13) + \dots\). \(3n\) terms ko 3 par divide karein to \(n\) groups bante hain. Har group ek "nayi term" ban jayega.

Har group ka jama
\[3 + 5 - 7 = 1\]
\[9 + 11 - 13 = 7\]
\[15 + 17 - 19 = 13\]
Kyun: Pehle chand groups haath se jama kiye taake pattern nazar aaye. Yeh nayi series 1, 7, 13, ... hai.

Group ke jame A.P. hain
\[1,\ 7,\ 13,\ \dots\]
\[a_1 = 1,\quad d = 6,\quad n \text{ terms}\]
Kyun: Har group ke teeno numbers pichhle group se 6 zyada hain (teen qadam, har qadam 2). Do numbers plus aur ek minus hai, to group ka jama \(6 + 6 - 6 = 6\) barhta hai. Is liye group-jame A.P. hain jis mein \(d = 6\), aur kul \(n\) groups hain.

\(n\) group-jamon ka jama
\[S = \dfrac{n}{2}[2(1) + (n - 1)6]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(6n - 4)\]
\[= n(3n - 2)\]
Kyun: Nayi A.P. par \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) lagaya: \(2 + 6n - 6 = 6n - 4\). Phir \(6n - 4\) ko 2 se divide kiya: \(3n - 2\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan terms ki tadaad \(n\) hai, \(3n\) nahi, kyunke hum groups jama kar rahe hain, asal terms nahi.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 2\) (6 terms)
\[3 + 5 - 7 + 9 + 11 - 13 = 8\]
\[2(3 \cdot 2 - 2) = 2 \times 4 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehli 6 terms haath se jama kin to 8 aaya, aur formula bhi 8 de raha hai. Jawab \(n\) ki shakal mein ho to chhote \(n\) se check karna sab se achha tareeqa hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(S_{3n} = n(3n - 2)\)
Answer key bhi \(n(3n - 2)\) deti hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul part (i) jaisa hai: signs plus, plus, minus dohra rahe hain.
Diya kya hai? Series aur \(3n\) terms.
Find kya karna hai? Jama.
Plan: teen teen ke \(n\) groups, har group ka jama, woh jame A.P. mein, phir A.P. ka jama. Pehle khud try kijiye, phir neeche milaiye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 + 4 - 7 + 10 + 13 - 16 + \dots\) \(3n\) terms tak.
Humein find karna hai: jama.
Tareeqa: Signs ke baghair numbers 1, 4, 7, 10, ... 3, 3 barh rahe hain. Teen teen ke groups: \((1 + 4 - 7) + (10 + 13 - 16) + \dots\), kul \(n\) groups.

Har group ka jama
\[1 + 4 - 7 = -2\]
\[10 + 13 - 16 = 7\]
\[19 + 22 - 25 = 16\]
Kyun: Pehle chand groups ka jama nikala. Pehla group negative aaya, \(-2\); is se ghabraiye nahi, A.P. negative se bhi shuru ho sakti hai.

Group ke jame A.P. hain
\[-2,\ 7,\ 16,\ \dots\]
\[a_1 = -2,\quad d = 9,\quad n \text{ terms}\]
Kyun: Har group ke numbers pichhle group se 9 zyada hain (teen qadam, har qadam 3). Group ka jama \(9 + 9 - 9 = 9\) barhta hai. \(7 - (-2) = 9\) aur \(16 - 7 = 9\) se bhi tasdeeq ho gayi.

\(n\) group-jamon ka jama
\[S = \dfrac{n}{2}[2(-2) + (n - 1)9]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(-4 + 9n - 9)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(9n - 13)\]
Kyun: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) mein \(a_1 = -2\), \(d = 9\) rakha. \(2(-2) = -4\) aur \((n - 1)9 = 9n - 9\); jama \(9n - 13\).
Dhyan dein: \(2a_1\) mein minus sign na bhooliye; \(+4\) likhne se jawab \(\frac{n}{2}(9n - 5)\) aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 2\) (6 terms)
\[1 + 4 - 7 + 10 + 13 - 16 = 5\]
\[\dfrac{2}{2}(18 - 13) = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Haath se jama 5 aaya aur formula bhi 5 de raha hai.
